Illustrative political simulation: real countries, fictional parties. Unzip and run, nothing to install.

| Platform | File | Start |
|---|---|---|
| Linux (x86_64) | `*-linux.tar.gz` | `tar xzf ...; ./OpenPolitics/OpenPolitics.x86_64` |
| Windows (x86_64) | `*-windows.zip` | unzip, run `OpenPolitics.exe` (Windows SmartScreen may warn: the build is not code-signed, choose *More info, Run anyway*) |
| macOS (Apple silicon and Intel) | `*-macos.zip` | unzip, then right-click `OpenPolitics.app` and *Open* (the app is not notarized; if macOS says it is damaged, run `xattr -cr OpenPolitics.app`) |

Saves are kept in Godot's user data folder. The game, its data packs and the Inter font are under MIT, CC BY-SA 4.0 and SIL OFL;
the licences are in the `licenses` folder of every download. Early development: expect rough edges, please report them as issues.
